nodes.label: caveman-commit: Terse Conventional Commits Skill
nodes.rationale: Enforces Conventional Commits with a <=50-char (72 hard cap) imperative subject and a body only when the why isn't obvious — required for breaking changes, security fixes, migrations, and reverts. No AI attribution, no restating the diff. Only generates the message; never stages, commits, or amends.

nodes.label: Java 17/21 JVM Compatibility Args Injection
nodes.rationale: Mojang version.json arguments.jvm omits module-access flags needed by Java 17+ (--add-modules=jdk.incubator.vector, --enable-native-access=ALL-UNNAMED, and --sun-misc-unsafe-memory-access=allow for 21+); without them LWJGL throws IllegalAccessError. collect_args/java_compat_args inject them before -cp.

nodes.label: Apple Silicon (arm64) LWJGL/Java Native Compatibility Layer
nodes.rationale: Mojang's 1.18.x-and-earlier LWJGL natives are x86_64-only; on arm64 Java this crashes RenderSystem. mc_compat.rs implements Prism-style MacosArm64Override tables (LWJGL3 3.3.1 for 1.13-1.18, community-compiled LWJGL2 for <=1.12) that swap classpath entries and natives based on detected Java architecture, falling back to Rosetta x64 when arm64 Java/LWJGL isn't available.

nodes.label: Java Version Selection: Global/Instance/Custom Modes

nodes.label: System Java Scan + Native File Picker
nodes.rationale: scan_system_javas() probes common per-OS install locations (JVM dirs, Homebrew, JAVA_HOME, sdkman/asdf, JetBrains ~/.jdks) so users can pick from a list instead of typing a path; rfd AsyncFileDialog with the xdg-portal backend on Linux avoids a GTK3 build dependency for AppImage packaging.

nodes.label: Prism-Style Instance Detail Window (11 Tabs)

nodes.label: GLFW setWindowIcon / Service-Port Boot Crash Fix (macOS)
nodes.rationale: 1.13-1.18 unconditionally call glfwSetWindowIcon at boot (no OS guard until 1.19); LWJGL 3.3.x's GLFW 3.4-dev raises error 65548 which the boot error callback treats as fatal, while LWJGL 3.2.3's older GLFW hits a separate 'service port for display' error 65544 on modern macOS (Tahoe). Fix: swap in MinecraftMachina's patched lwjgl-glfw bindings jar (nglfwSetWindowIcon becomes a Java-level no-op) atop LWJGL 3.3.1, used for both arm64 and x64 override tables.
nodes.norm_label: glfw setwindowicon / service-port boot crash fix (macos)

nodes.label: Instance List / Dropdown Scroll Virtualization
nodes.rationale: Full-list re-instantiation on every scroll/search keystroke caused lag: PNG icons loaded from disk on each render (fixed by embedding an Assets.logo fallback), InstanceCard virtualization added via an in-viewport flag with quantized integer row-index bounds, and create-dialog version dropdowns switched from ScrollView+for to Slint's built-in lazily-instantiated ListView.

nodes.label: Offline-First Launch (Local-Metadata Fallback)
nodes.rationale: do_launch previously required network for version JSON, Java runtime manifest, asset index, and the Forge installer on every launch. Changed to local-first: use cached files under versions/<id>, indexes/<id>.json, and existing runtime/Forge-profile directories when present, only fetching on the first-ever launch of a version.

nodes.label: App Hangs on Close While Game Running — Fix
nodes.rationale: spawn_log_reader used tokio::task::spawn_blocking to read game stdout/stderr; tokio's runtime waits for all blocking tasks to finish on drop, but the pipe only EOFs when the game exits, hanging app shutdown. Fixed by using std::thread::spawn (independent OS thread, reclaimed on process exit) instead.
nodes.norm_label: app hangs on close while game running — fix

nodes.label: on_save_settings handler (src/view/launch.rs)
nodes.rationale: Previously built AppSettings as a fresh struct literal, silently resetting sort_mode/sort_ascending to defaults on every Java-settings save; fixed to load-then-mutate so the two settings cards don't clobber each other.

nodes.label: InstanceStore::record_launch_started
nodes.rationale: Kept on InstanceStore rather than inline in the launch closure so it is unit-testable without a real child process; sets last_played the moment a launch succeeds, matching official-launcher convention and surviving a hard-killed launcher.

nodes.label: InstanceStore::record_play_session_end
nodes.rationale: Accumulates (+=) play_time_secs rather than overwriting; write must complete synchronously before the pending-quit decision is evaluated for the same exit event.

nodes.label: on_close_requested handler (src/view/mod.rs)
nodes.rationale: Minimizes instead of quitting when running_procs is non-empty; the app only actually quits once every running instance has exited cleanly, and any crash while pending_quit is set restores the window instead.

nodes.label: pending_quit AtomicBool flag
nodes.rationale: Coordinates the deferred-quit decision between on_close_requested and the exit-poll loop: a clean exit while set actually quits the app; any instance crashing while set immediately cancels the deferred quit and restores the window, regardless of other still-running instances.

nodes.label: Create Instance Dialog Feature
nodes.rationale: 3-tab dialog (Basic/Advanced/Resources) backed by InstanceCreateLogic global and InstanceConfig/InstanceStore TOML persistence; confirm-create writes TOML synchronously on the UI thread since files are small.

nodes.label: Instance List Sort Settings (Name/Version/CreatedAt/LastPlayed)
nodes.rationale: InstanceStore::load() is the single sort authority all call sites (startup, append, file-watch refresh) funnel through, so the sort preference only needs applying once inside load(). AppSettings::load() is deliberately NOT called inside InstanceStore itself, to keep mc_instance.rs's tempdir-based unit tests hermetic — sort_mode/sort_ascending are instead injected via set_sort() from callers.

nodes.label: Play-Session Tracking (last_played/play_time_secs) + Close-to-Minimize
nodes.rationale: last_played is written the moment launch succeeds (matches official-launcher convention: record session start, not end, so a hard-killed launcher doesn't lose the record); play_time_secs accumulates in the exit-watch poll loop. on_close_requested minimizes instead of quitting while running_procs is non-empty, deferring quit via a pending_quit AtomicBool that either triggers slint::quit_event_loop() on clean all-exit or restores the window on any abnormal exit.

nodes.label: Auto-Minimize Main Window on Instance Launch
nodes.rationale: Window minimizes automatically the moment do_launch's Ok(child) branch fires (game process successfully spawned), independent of and orthogonal to the existing close-while-running-minimizes and crash-restore behaviors; no toggle, consistent with the precedent set by close-to-minimize having none either (YAGNI).
nodes.norm_label: auto-minimize main window on instance launch

nodes.label: World/Resource/Shader Pack Path Redirection via Symlink/Junction
nodes.rationale: Redirection happens at launch time via a directory-level symlink (macOS/Linux) or NTFS junction (Windows, via the junction crate — avoids requiring Developer Mode/admin elevation that std::os::windows::fs::symlink_dir would need), never by copying files. sync_custom_dirs refuses to replace a real non-empty directory to avoid silently deleting user-added mods/resourcepacks, and runs before any network/download work for fail-fast behavior.
nodes.norm_label: world/resource/shader pack path redirection via symlink/junction
